name: Variable-scoped S3 read (boundary)
note: IAM-706 (acceptance test 21 shape): s3:GetObject on a policy-VARIABLE-scoped resource (${aws:username}). The ARN cannot be resolved from the policy text, so DATA-READ fires with the variable preserved verbatim and lower path-exploitability. This is the decision boundary between a concrete named read and an unresolvable variable read. Must NOT fire DATA-EXFIL (not broad) or WILDCARD-RESOURCE.
